open_app.description: Open an app by the name Windows knows it by: notepad, calc, mspaint, explorer, msedge, chrome, code, spotify.

open_path.description: Open a file or folder in its default app, for example C:/Users/You/Desktop.

open_url.description: Open a web address in the default browser.

say.description: Speak a sentence out loud on the laptop.

volume_up.description: Press the volume-up media key a few times.

volume_down.description: Press the volume-down media key a few times.

media_play_pause.description: Press play/pause on whatever is playing.

screenshot.description: Save a screenshot to Pictures/JARVIS and print the file path.
screenshot.script: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms,System.Drawing; $dir = [IO.Path]::Combine($env:USERPROFILE, 'Pictures', 'JARVIS'); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; $path = [IO.Path]::Combine($dir, 'shot-' + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.png'); $b = [System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::VirtualScreen; $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $b.Width, $b.Height; $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp); $g.CopyFromScreen($b.Left, $b.Top, 0, 0, $bmp.Size); $bmp.Save($path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png); $g.Dispose(); $bmp.Dispose(); Write-Output $path

battery.script: Get-CimInstance Win32_Battery | Select-Object BatteryStatus, EstimatedChargeRemaining, EstimatedRunTime | Format-List | Out-String

disk.description: Free and used space per drive.
disk.script: Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name, @{Name='UsedGB';Expression={[math]::Round($_.Used / 1GB, 1)}}, @{Name='FreeGB';Expression={[math]::Round($_.Free / 1GB, 1)}}, Root | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String

running.description: The twenty processes using the most memory.
running.script: Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 Name, Id, @{Name='RAM_MB';Expression={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64 / 1MB)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String

ip.script: Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' } | Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPAddress, PrefixLength | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String

whoami.description: Current Windows user and machine name.

uptime.description: How long the laptop has been on.
aliases: how long has the laptop been on
how long has my laptop been on

wifi.description: The Wi-Fi network this laptop is on.

git_status.description: Git status and the last commit for a folder (defaults to the agent working directory).
git_status.preview: git -C <path or workdir> status -sb; git log -1 --oneline
git_status.script: $p = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:JARVIS_ARG_PATH)) { $env:JARVIS_WORKDIR } else { $env:JARVIS_ARG_PATH }; git -C $p status -sb; git -C $p log -1 --oneline

list_files.description: List a folder (defaults to the agent working directory).
list_files.script: $p = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:JARVIS_ARG_PATH)) { $env:JARVIS_WORKDIR } else { $env:JARVIS_ARG_PATH }; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p | Select-Object Mode, LastWriteTime, Length, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
